Before opening an issue, search existing issues for the same problem or suggestion.
Report security vulnerabilities privately using the [security policy](https://github.com/valksor/margrave/blob/master/SECURITY.md).

## Issue type

- [ ] Bug report
- [ ] Feature request

For a bug, list the steps that show the problem.
